title: Scoped negative result: PR589's bit word is exactly transport-locally optimal (no new kappa)
body:
Closes the gate-order door that `bit589-frame-optimum` left open: *"future bit headroom on this word must come from gate-order or structural changes."*

**Claim.** With PR589's gate multiset, operands, scatter, start/final, D, rebuilt-C and retained-total COPY frames fixed, no transport (relocating one elementary addition to any position in its exact commutation window at any legal catalogue or closure frame) lowers the moment at the exact saving c = 1733427039589844234749/10^24 — and neither does any pair of simultaneous transports sharing a register.

**Method.** Independent enumerator (no contributor tuner code in the decision path), standard library only. Exact outward rational prices from the pinned moment engine (sha256 aee70c24…); no float decides a comparison. Objective is the full per-register frame-chain cost + scatter tops, verified to reproduce the replay paid profile exactly (this also repairs the tuner's section-local model, which double-counts the last-A→first-B climb and ignores D). Legality cross-checked by applying sample moves, rebuilding C, and full exact replay (8/8 profiles match predictions).

**Census.** A: 2130 ops, 5830 legal non-home placements → 5580 same-profile, 250 strictly worse, **0 improving**, smallest strict loss 8.0e−6. B: 934 ops, 3561 placements → 3226 / 335 / **0**, smallest loss 1.9e−3. Pairs: 13673 + 6006 shared-register pairs, 443,600 combinations, **0 improving**, 0 unresolved. Disjoint-register simultaneous moves decompose additively, so they cannot improve either.

**Scope.** Bit side does not bind the selected kappa (a_c = 0.0016754627 < a_b = 0.0017334270, 3.46% slack) — no new kappa, same scope as the accepted seed-16 bit-track precedents. Simultaneity certified for pairs, not triples+ (giant components); Steinberg/structural moves out of scope.

Reproduce: `bash research/bit589-transport-atlas/verify.sh` (~70 s, PASS_BIT589_TRANSPORT_ATLAS). Base commit bce54fb3. Seed 10 (bit supplier track).
